The Freestyle Floorplanner App makes it quick, fun and easy to design your next fantastic Dressage to Music floorplan. Simply select the level you're designing for and get going with our simple, colourful design screen. Keep track of the compulsory moves you need to include with our handy check list system, which will also help you avoid making the classic mistake of including prohibited moves. The app also gives you an estimate of the time your floorplan will take to complete, though of course this will vary depending on your horse!


Stuck for inspiration? Get some ideas to really make your next floorpan flow with one of the Design Inspiration packages (available as in-app purchase) from international Grand Prix rider Stephanie Croxford. Each package has 9 patterns, 3 for walk, 3 for trot and 3 for canter all aimed at a specific level.


At this time, we have the options for freestyle tests in Great Britain, the USA, Australia and New Zeland. We also include the FEI tests from PSG to Grand Prix as well as FEI Para tests for Grades I to V. If your country’s tests aren’t included, there’s still the option to “build your own” plan, where you can select the compulsory and prohibited moves for your level from a list. 


You can choose either long or short arena, depending on your test or venue.


An important thing to note:
You will need the official GB federation test sheet if you're doing a floorplan from Intro to Advanced Medium as you'll need to manually set your moves checklist using our super-easy to use list system. Once you've added a checklist, you can always reuse it again to make things a little easier! For all other tests, so FEI PSG and up, and all other countries, the check list is already done for you. Despite the filled checklists for the other countries, we still recommend that you refer back to the official test sheet when creating your floorplan.


Finally, a quick word about pricing. Once you've bought the app, it's yours and you can design as many floorplans as you like for no extra cost. So there's no subscription or ongoing costs for floorplan design. The Design Inspiration packages are available as optional in-app purchases. Once you've bought a package, it's yours forever!

I'll be honest - I wrote this App as I was fed up with calculating Dinghy Race Results for my local club using Sailwave. It was just taking too much time!

I wanted something quick and easy to use that allowed me to set up boats and competitors and then allow me to publish the results to my local club website. I didn't want to type much and I wanted to see results at any point during the race.

If you race a boat with a sail then this is the App for you! 

Quick entry of:
- Series
- Races
- Boats

It includes the ability to add helm, crew, sail number and Portsmouth Yardstick numbers (RYA 2021 and 2019) are included but you can add your own if you want. App includes drop downs of previous competitor information so that new series/races can be added *very* quickly.

Race results (per lap) can be added automatically or manually using a simple clear interface. After racing is complete results can be emailed to one or more recipients.

Race start sequence counts down from -5 minutes with appropriate 'beeps' at 5,4,1,0 minutes.

Results are available immediately, so you can see the current results even if the race is still in progress.

Results can be emailed or copied to the clipboard - easy to add to club website.

Series can be exported and imported between Apps
